name: Puff
title: Puffin Sailor
description: Sails small boats through big data lakes.
catchphrase: Sails small boats through big data lakes.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Six shiny little capelin fish in beak all at once! Proud honk! 🐟🐧
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Flapping colorful beak and orange webbed feet on the cliff edge! 🐧
companionPersonality.petReaction: Clumsy affectionate waddle and a gentle colorful beak tap! 🐧💖

dialogue.idle: Standing on grassy cliff ledge above crashing Atlantic surf. 🐧
dialogue.working: Diving into rough stormy data lakes and surfacing with results! 🐧⚡
dialogue.thinking: Watching wave crests to time the deep foraging dive... 🤔
dialogue.success: BEAK FULL! Returned to nest with all required payloads! 🐧🎉
dialogue.error: A big wave tossed him onto the beach! Shaking feathers dry! 🌊
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... tucked cozy inside a clifftop burrow safe from gales... 🌙
